description: This file defines a React component for the initial page of an import modal interface, allowing users to drag-and-drop files or select files for import, supporting multiple import services like Evernote, Google Keep, Simplenote, Aegis Authenticator, Plaintext, and Markdown.

methods.name: selectFiles
methods.description: An async callback that opens a file picker or handles dropped files, dispatching an action with the selected files and optional service type.
